Each supplied regular Git superset excludes Gitlinks/nonregular payload without inspection and reconstructs via exact object/byte/hash/mode manifests; three explicit case/probe/fixture overlays, no production replacement. This is not minimal IO. Two complete44-command captures each retain42 source/seed pairs,14-group RED and six complete consumers144. Twenty evidence and five exact instrument controls are record/source falsifiers, not runtime semantic mutants. Original318 hashes freeze only mode/revision; five denials verify it. Actual initial Toolbox capsule retains the tool-returned combined channel, not unavailable separate stdout/stderr. Display schema error source and actual recurrence retain original traceback context; no universal first-error replay identity is inferred. Three built-in traces per initial/corrected population,58 complete book inputs/capsule/full render channels/seven exact examples and11 effective controls retain source coverage. Necessary read-only OS/Perl/Python/mdBook inputs; all project data repository-local/same-volume. No production/test/CI/hook/contract/dependency change or new syntax/backend admission, no readiness claim from healthy values. Private handoff/mapped replacement and canonical .0.3.2 stay open; recurring .0.4, diagnostic origin and comments retain owners. Dated Phase0 metadata is separately scheduled REPO-HYGIENE.12, without a new universal performance claim. Other repositories are read-only.
